limitations: Historical descriptive UCI Iris dataset (Fisher 1936); means and ranges are descriptive statistics, not evidence of perfect classification or causal relationships.
Computed with Python 3.11 standard library (csv, hashlib, json); no external packages installed, no network access.
Executed code: compute_species_summary.py; receipts computed from actual attachment bytes via hashlib.sha256.
data_audit.json verified to exactly match source-iris.csv rows, source_sha256, record_count 150, and species counts 50 each.
result.conclusion_zh: 基于150条历史公开记录(单位cm),三种鸢尾花各50条。花瓣长度均值排序为 Iris-setosa < Iris-versicolor < Iris-virginica(均值分别为 1.462, 4.26, 5.552 cm)。versicolor 花瓣长度观测范围 [3.0,5.1] cm 与 virginica 范围 [4.5,6.9] cm 存在重叠。这些是描述性统计,不构成完美分类或因果结论。
result.citation: Fisher, R. (1936). Iris [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/53/iris, DOI: 10.24432/C56C76, CC BY 4.0.
